title: beta vulgaris var. hortensis
intro: Beta vulgaris var. hortensis, commonly known as garden beet or sugar beet, is a variety of beetroot that is cultivated for its edible leaves and roots. This plant has been found to have numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high content of fiber, vitamins, and minerals. The bioactive constituents of garden beet include nitrates, flavonoids, and betalains, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as reducing blood pressure, protecting against oxidative stress, and exhibiting antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The leaves and roots of Beta vulgaris var. hortensis have been used in traditional medicine for their potential therapeutic benefits, making it a valuable plant in the field of phytomedicine.
